stops.text: 12 REUNION · A Welcome home in the hall — “Decades later”
12 REUNION · B Loud voices, overheard hearts — “loud voices so our hearts can be overheard”
12 REUNION · C The empty rooms of the afterlife — “My mind drifts into the darkness of our afterlives”
12 REUNION · D Hourglasses and the group photo (archival reenactment) — “We are all here”
12 REUNION · E Trees at the forest edge — “grateful to every living tree in the forest”
12 REUNION · F Brotherhood chain — “This is brotherhood.”
12 REUNION · G Football in the meadow, then home — “follow paths of hilltops and canyons”
